entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: ...Yes, of course. I will continue accepting[n]them even after I am inaugurated as prime[n]minister.

entries.speaker: Politician Ooe
entries.en: As expected from you, Mr. Shido. You are[n]a truly reliable man.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: And in return, I only ask for your[n]continued support... Standing up to[n]the world does require money.

entries.speaker: Politician Ooe
entries.en: Of course. I'll make sure to prepare[n]compensation as thanks for your help[n]in "cleaning up."

entries.speaker: Politician Ooe
entries.en: The incident with that accident in spring[n]was very beneficial. This is all thanks to[n]you, sir.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: If the study of cognitive psience[n]progresses, I believe it's possible[n]to increase the target range.

entries.speaker: Politician Ooe
entries.en: *chuckle* I bid you good luck with that[n]endeavor. I hope you will continue to[n]assist us.
